steps.title: Welcome to the yard
lines: This is the Vesta training yard. Nothing here can hurt you.
Follow the cards. You can leave any time from the menu.

steps.title: Fly through the rings
lines: Thrust with {forward}, steer with the mouse.
Fly through the three marked rings.

steps.title: Stop in the zone
lines: Ships keep moving until you slow them. Thrust back with {backward}.
Come to a stop inside the marked zone.

steps.title: Shoot the practice drones
lines: Aim with the mouse and fire with {fire}.
The drones do not shoot back. Break all three.

steps.title: Mine your rock
lines: Shoot the training rock until it breaks.
Then fly through the chunks to scoop up the ore.

steps.title: Open your hold
lines: Press {inventory} to see what you carry.
Ore you mine goes into the hold.

steps.title: Dock at the yard
lines: Fly into the station's docking ring and press {dock}.

steps.title: Refine your ore
lines: Open the refinery tab and turn ore into plate.
Plate is what ship parts are made of.

steps.title: Place a part
lines: Press {dock} at the station to open the hangar.
Place one hull cell on your ship and save.

steps.title: Add a generator
lines: In the hangar editor, place the Cell Reactor we gave you next to your core.
Press U in the editor to watch the power flow.

steps.title: The repair bank
lines: The bank holds materials that rebuild damaged parts.
Open its tab to see what it has.

steps.title: Field guide and map
lines: Press {components} for the field guide, then {map} for the system map.

steps.title: Jump to the marker
lines: Aim at the exit marker and press {jump} to spool the jump drive.

steps.title: Ready to fly
lines: That is the whole loop. You get a starter pack, and Sol is open to you.
